scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; tailwindcss -i app/styles.css -o app/public/styles.css --watch=always & NODE_ENV=development PORT=4000 node --watch --import remix/node-tsx server.ts
scripts.hmr: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; tailwindcss -i app/styles.css -o app/public/styles.css --watch=always & NODE_ENV=development PORT=4000 node hmr.ts
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test remix test --type server && cd ../.. && NODE_ENV=test remix test --type browser --glob.test 'packages/frontend-remix/app/**/*.test.browser.tsx'
